visual.general_description: Baseline and follow-up axial FLAIR brain MRI slices with arrows and a dose-colour legend, each above a grey 3D render of the tumor.
visual.detailed_description: Two axial grayscale brain slices are shown side by side above two grey 3D surface renders. Printed titles read "Baseline (t0)" over the left slice and "Follow-up (t5)" over the right slice. At the left, a legend headed "% irradiation dose" lists seven coloured circles labelled ≥100%, ≥95%, ≥90%, ≥70%, ≥50%, ≥30% and ≥10% (magenta, red, orange, yellow, green, cyan, blue). Each axial slice carries the printed letters R and L at its left and right sides. On the baseline slice, nested multicolour contour lines surround a bright, irregular mass, with a small dotted magenta outline inside the contours; one red arrow, one light blue arrow and one magenta arrow are drawn on it. The follow-up slice shows a bright irregular mass with an adjacent rounded structure, no contour lines, and one red arrow, two light blue arrows and one magenta arrow. A dark region lies at the edge of the head on each slice near the magenta arrow tip. A grey downward arrow below each slice leads to a grey 3D render; the letter A is printed beneath each arrow, the letter P below each render, and R and L beside each render. The baseline render has a thin pointed projection on one side, while the follow-up render has a more compact outline. A bottom legend prints a red arrow with "Tumor Mass", a light blue arrow with "Lateral and Posterior cysts" and a magenta arrow with "VPS-induced artifact". No patient name, identifier, institution or date is printed.

panels.general_description: Line chart of percent change of FA, FAt, FW and MD relative to baseline at t0 to t5.
panels.detailed_description: Line chart titled "B) Diffusion scalars percent change relative to baseline". Legend titled "Diffusion scalars": FA (solid salmon line), FAt (dotted green line), FW (dash-dot cyan line), MD (dashed lilac line). The y axis is labelled "% change w.r.t. baseline (t0)" with printed ticks -20, -10, 0, 10 and 20; the x axis is labelled "Time point (t)" with boxes t0, t1 to t4 and t5. A grey dashed horizontal reference line spans the plot and each line carries a round marker at every time point. In shape, the FA line falls, then rises over t2 to t4 and falls steeply at t5; the FW and MD lines run close together from t1 to t4 and both rise steeply at t5; the FAt line dips, then rises, and eases at t5. No data labels are printed.

panels.general_description: Four violin plots of FA, FAt, MD and FW distributions in solid tumor voxels at t0 to t5 with printed r values and significance symbols.
panels.detailed_description: Four violin-plot subpanels under the heading "C) Distributions of values of diffusion indices from solid tumor portions: FW < 0.95", each with six violins for t0 to t5 and a narrow white box with a vertical whisker line inside every violin. Subpanels: "Fractional Anisotropy (FA)" (salmon, y ticks 0 to 1.0), "tissue Fractional Anisotropy (FAt)" (green, y ticks 0 to 1.0), "Mean Diffusivity (MD)" (lilac, y ticks 0 to 3.0×10^-3 in steps of 0.5×10^-3) and "Free Water (FW)" (cyan, y ticks 0 to 1.0). Above each subpanel are seven brackets with a printed r value and significance symbol: FA r = 0.099, 0.063, 0.13, 0.147, 0.378 (adjacent pairs), 0.236 and 0.168 (longer brackets), all ****; FAt r = 0.044 (****), 0.014 (**), 0.084, 0.171, 0.056, 0.203, 0.144 (all ****); MD r = 0.1 (****), 0.01 (ns), 0.054 (****), 0.014 (**), 0.279 (****), 0.011 (ns), 0.346 (****); FW r = 0.075, 0.028, 0.061, 0.03, 0.338, 0.053, 0.343 (all ****). The x axis of every subpanel is labelled "Time point (t)" with boxes t0, t1 to t4 and t5. Violin silhouettes differ in width and outline between time points.
